questions.stem: Q1. A 25-year-old man presents with recurrent dark red plaques on his penis. He reports that these lesions appear shortly after taking certain medications. The patches are localized and recur in the same areas with each exposure. He denies any other symptoms or systemic involvement. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the diagnosis?
questions.stemHtml: Q1. A 25-year-old man presents with recurrent dark red plaques on his penis. He reports that these lesions appear shortly after taking certain medications. The patches are localized and recur in the same areas with each exposure. He denies any other symptoms or systemic involvement. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Resolution of lesions without any visible skin lesions.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a type 1 hypersensitivity reaction

options.label: C
options.text: Upon re-exposure Lesions develop on the 10th day.

options.label: D
options.text: Tetracyclines are commonly associated with FDE

questions.stemHtml: Q1. A 32-year-old woman comes to the dermatology OPD with lesions on her cheeks that aggravate when exposed to sunlight, as shown in the image below. questions.stem: Q1. A 30-year-old patient complains of increased skin pigmentation following prolonged sun exposure. Which of the following statements regarding melanin physiology is most accurate?
questions.stemHtml: Q1. A 30-year-old patient complains of increased skin pigmentation following prolonged sun exposure. Which of the following statements regarding melanin physiology is most accurate?

options.label: A
options.text: Melanocytes primarily produce eumelanin, responsible for skin pigmentation and protection against UV radiation.

options.label: B
options.text: Tyrosinase is an enzyme that converts tyrosine to melanin in keratinocytes.

options.label: C
options.text: Melanosome transfer from melanocytes to keratinocytes occurs via exocytosis.

options.label: D
options.text: Individuals with albinism have increased melanin production due to mutations in the MC1R gene.
